content: Lenacapavir, a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, can increase the levels or effects of drugs metabolized by the CYP3A4 enzyme. This interaction may elevate the risk of adverse reactions associated with these drugs. The following are specific interactions and recommendations for monitoring or adjusting therapy when lenacapavir is co-administered with other medications: 1. CYP3A4 Substrates: Lenacapavir may increase the levels of CYP3A4 substrates initiated within nine months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir. This can heighten the risk of adverse reactions. Close monitoring is advised. 2. Armodafinil: Lenacapavir increases armodafinil levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Conversely, armodafinil decreases lenacapavir levels. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. 3. Atazanavir: Lenacapavir increases atazanavir levels. Avoid co-administration with atazanavir/cobicistat or atazanavir/ritonavir. Use alternative therapies. 4. Drugs Inhibiting P-gp, UGT1A1, and Strong CYP3A Inhibitors: These drugs may significantly increase lenacapavir plasma concentrations. Monitor closely. 5. Atorvastatin, Avanafil, Avapritinib, Avatrombopag, Axitinib: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 6. Belzutifan: Belzutifan decreases lenacapavir levels. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. 7. Bexarotene: Bexarotene decreases lenacapavir levels. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. 8. Bortezomib: Lenacapavir increases bortezomib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Bosentan: Lenacapavir increases bosentan levels, while bosentan decreases lenacapavir levels. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. 10. Brexpiprazole, Bromocriptine, Buprenorphine (all formulations): Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use the lowest feasible dose of buprenorphine when initiating therapy with lenacapavir and titrate carefully. Monitor clinical signs and symptoms. 11. Buspirone, Busulfan: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Butabarbital, Butalbital: These drugs decrease lenacapavir levels. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. 13. Cabozantinib, Calcifediol, Cannabidiol, Capivasertib: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. For capivasertib, reduce the dose if co-administered with lenacapavir. 14. Carbamazepine: Carbamazepine decreases lenacapavir levels. Co-administration is contraindicated. 15. Cariprazine: Lenacapavir increases cariprazine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Cenobamate: Cenobamate decreases lenacapavir levels. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. 17. Ceritinib, Chloroquine, Chlorpheniramine: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 18. Ciclesonide (inhaled and intranasal): Lenacapavir increases ciclesonide levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Cilostazol, Cisapride, Citalopram: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. Clarithromycin, Clonazepam, Clorazepate: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 21. Cobicistat, Cobimetinib, Cocaine (topical): Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 22. Colchicine, Conivaptan, Conjugated Estrogens: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Copanlisib: Lenacapavir increases copanlisib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Cortisone: Lenacapavir significantly increases cortisone levels, potentially leading to toxicities such as Cushing syndrome or adrenal suppression. Initiate dexamethasone at the lowest dose, monitor, and titrate accordingly. 25. Crizotinib, Cyclophosphamide, Cyclosporine: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Dabigatran: Lenacapavir increases dabigatran levels. Refer to prescribing information for guidance on co-administration with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. 27. Dabrafenib: Dabrafenib decreases lenacapavir levels. Avoid co-administration or use alternative drugs. 28. Daclatasvir: Lenacapavir increases daclatasvir levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Danicopan: Danicopan increases lenacapavir levels. Consider dose reduction of P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious adverse reactions. 30. Dantrolene, Dapsone, Daridorexant, Darifenacin, Darolutamide, Darunavir: Lenacapavir increases the levels of these drugs. Use caution and monitor closely. 31. Dasatinib: Lenacapavir increases dasatinib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Deflazacort: Lenacapavir increases deflazacort levels. Administer one-third of the recommended deflazacort dose when co-administered with lenacapavir (e.g., reduce a 36 mg/day dose to 12 mg/day). Monitor closely. 33. Dexamethasone: Lenacapavir increases dexamethasone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. In all cases, careful monitoring of clinical signs and symptoms is essential to mitigate the risk of adverse reactions. Adjust dosages as necessary based on the specific drug interaction.
